description: Downloads the Pi this build of VibeOS pins for linux agents, checks it against its release's SHA256SUMS and makes it a new layer, which their next fresh boot takes. It takes as long as the download does, and a pi.changed event tells other clients.

alerts: brave-copper-lynx signed in to xai, and every Pi agent here now uses that login. If that wasn't you, sign in to it in Settings → Agents to replace it.
